title: Teamwork.com pricing - Free for 5 users, then $10.99-$69.99 per user/month
clean_text: Teamwork.com's Free plan is limited to 5 users and a small number of projects with 100 automations per month. Paid tiers (annual billing) are Deliver at roughly $10.99-$13.99/user/month (3-user minimum, 300 active projects, 100GB storage), Grow at $25.99/user/month, and Scale at $69.99/user/month. Pricing is per-user and scales linearly with team size.
